movementSlotRegistry.description: All possible slot types the engine can populate. Engine selects appropriate exercise based on goal, level, equipment, and recovery.

slots.pulse_raise_slot: Low-intensity cardio movement to raise heart rate and core temperature
slots.dynamic_mobility_slot: Active mobility drills for joint range of motion preparation
slots.activation_slot: Targeted muscle activation (glutes, core, shoulders, lats)
slots.lower_body_push_machine_slot: Machine-based squat or leg press pattern
slots.upper_push_slot: Horizontal or vertical push – push-up, press pattern
slots.upper_pull_slot: Horizontal or vertical pull – row, pull-up pattern
slots.hinge_slot: Hip hinge pattern – deadlift, Romanian deadlift, good morning
slots.core_anti_extension_slot: Anti-extension core – plank variations, ab wheel
slots.core_anti_rotation_slot: Anti-rotation core – Pallof press, bird dog
slots.core_rotation_slot: Rotational core – wood chop, Russian twist
slots.core_slot: General core movement – engine selects based on session balance
slots.unilateral_lower_slot: Single-leg lower body – lunge, step-up, split squat
slots.single_leg_slot: Single-leg movement – balance or strength focused
slots.lateral_movement_slot: Lateral plane movement – side lunge, lateral shuffle
slots.explosive_lower_slot: Plyometric or explosive leg drive – jump squat, box jump
slots.explosive_power_slot: Full body explosive – broad jump, med ball slam, power clean
slots.reactive_lower_slot: Reactive plyometric – depth jump, reactive bound
slots.cardio_burst_slot: High-intensity cardio – sprint, jump rope, burpee, mountain climber
slots.full_body_compound_slot: Multi-joint full body movement – thruster, clean and press, kettlebell swing
slots.compound_lower_slot: Compound lower body – any level-appropriate squat or hinge
slots.compound_upper_push_slot: Compound upper push – bench, overhead press, push-up variation
slots.strength_compound_slot: Heavy compound movement – engine chooses based on goal and equipment
slots.agility_slot: Agility and coordination drill – ladder, cone, reactive movement
slots.balance_slot: Balance and proprioception – single-leg, bosu, unstable surface
slots.isolation_upper_slot: Isolation upper body – curl, extension, raise, fly
slots.isolation_lower_slot: Isolation lower body – leg curl, leg extension, calf raise
slots.barbell_lower_push_slot: Barbell squat pattern – squat, front squat, hack squat
slots.barbell_upper_push_slot: Barbell press pattern – bench press, overhead press
slots.barbell_hinge_slot: Barbell hinge – deadlift, RDL, good morning
slots.barbell_upper_pull_slot: Barbell pull – bent-over row, Pendlay row
slots.machine_upper_push_slot: Chest press machine, shoulder press machine
slots.machine_hinge_slot: Romanian deadlift machine, lying leg curl
slots.cable_upper_push_slot: Cable chest fly, cable overhead press
slots.dumbbell_unilateral_lower_slot: Dumbbell split squat, step-up, reverse lunge
slots.cardio_machine_slot: Treadmill, bike, rower, assault bike, elliptical
slots.static_stretch_lower_slot: Lower body static stretching – hip flexors, hamstrings, quads, glutes
slots.static_stretch_upper_slot: Upper body static stretching – chest, shoulders, lats, triceps
slots.breathwork_slot: Controlled breathing protocol – box breathing, diaphragmatic breathing
slots.mobility_lower_slot: Active lower body mobility – hip CARs, ankle circles, knee circles
slots.mobility_upper_slot: Active upper body mobility – shoulder CARs, thoracic rotation
slots.thoracic_mobility_slot: Thoracic spine mobility – cat-cow, t-spine rotation, open book

engineRules.description: Rules the workout generation engine must follow when populating skeletons
rules: Never assign an exercise to a slot that requires equipment not available to the user
Always scale intensity based on recovery score before assigning movements
Beginner level slots must always have a regression available
Advanced level slots should include a progression path
Core slots must be balanced across anti-extension, anti-rotation, and rotation within a weekly plan
No two consecutive sessions should train the same primary movement pattern at high intensity
Cardio machine slot must offer at least 3 machine alternatives based on availability
Recovery LOW state: reduce total volume by 20-30%, extend rest periods by 20-30%
Recovery HIGH state: allow intensity increase, add optional finisher if skeleton includes one
Progression must be tracked – load, reps, rest, density, or complexity
